enchantments.tooltip: Profane Well Rounded +2: +2 Profane bonus to all abilities.
Law Absorption +22%: Passive: 22% Enhancement Bonus to Law Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Good Absorption +22%: Passive: 22% Enhancement Bonus to Good Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
